en.sayed-ali-raza: Thereafter, Allāh inhabited Adam (p.b.u.h.) in a house where He made his life pleasant and his stay safe, and He cautioned him of Iblis and his enmity.
Then his enemy (Iblis) envied his abiding in Paradise and his contacts with the virtuous.
So he changed his conviction into wavering and determination into weakness. He thus converted his happiness into fear and his prestige into shame.
Then Allāh offered to Adam (p.b.u.h.) the chance to repent, taught him words of His Mercy, promised him return to His Paradise
and sent him down to the place of trial and procreation of progeny.
